pairs.subject: translation-quality-measurement
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/engine/build_session/tool_tests.rs:440 The build-session quality gate tests a draft persona's tools and connectors, not translated text. A case-insensitive search of every directory in this context found no estimator, MQM typology, chrF, quality-estimation or back-translation code. The only 'translat' hits are intent strings in gates.rs test fixtures (e.g. 'translate documents from english to czech') and per-language naming examples in session_prompt.rs, so there is no machine-translated store here to measure.

pairs.subject: translation-quality-measurement
pairs.evidence: src/stores/i18nStore.ts:13 The only i18n store holds the selected language, font readiness and setLanguage (lines 14-16), and it lazy-loads fonts for non-Latin scripts. Searching src/stores, src/api and src/hooks for the subject's vocabulary found nothing. The single 'translat' hit is authStore.ts reading an English string through getActiveTranslations, so no translated store is scored or reviewed here.

pairs.subject: translation-quality-measurement
pairs.evidence: src/i18n/generated/types.ts:2 This context's generated types come from the English source catalog only. Its tests pin the error-fallback chain, Rust/TS stop-reason parity, partial-core loading and section-load broadcast; none of them inspects translated values. The app ships English only: SHIPPED_UI_LOCALES = ['en'] at src/i18n/locales.manifest.ts:70. Searching src/i18n for mqm, chrf, quality_estimat and back_translat found nothing; 'glossary' appears only as UI keys such as glossary_webhook.
